procedure_steps.instruction: Dissolve 3.15 g NaOH in 25 mL ethanol and 30 mL water in a 250 mL beaker; cool to 20-25 degrees C.
procedure_steps.observation: The alkaline mixture is prepared before carbonyl addition.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Separately mix 3.2 mL benzaldehyde and 2.3 mL acetone; add half this mixture slowly with vigorous stirring, then stir 15 minutes.
